item.title: Photo | Pajaro Valley Quilt Association members prepare for 48th annual quilt show
item.description: The annual event will include over 300 quilts — from king-size award winners to small creative landscape pieces — and will feature speaker Greg Climer from the San Jose Museum of Quilts and Textiles.

item.title: Photos | Fog rolls in on Monterey Bay as rain set to resume
item.description: A thick fog bank covered much of the Monterey Bay Monday morning. The National Weather Service forecast for Santa Cruz County includes rain Tuesday through Thursday and then again on Saturday and Sunday. Low temperatures in the coming days are predicted to drop to near freezing at night.

item.title: Hong Kong fire victims long for home as Lunar New Year stirs painful memories
item.description: The Lunar New Year is stirring recent memories of celebrating in the burnt complex.

item.title: Guest Commentary | Offshore oil drilling is bad for business in Santa Cruz County
item.description: "As business leaders in Santa Cruz County, we strongly oppose offshore oil and gas development along the California coast," writes Kristen Brown, Terence Concannon and Melissa Mahoney in a Guest Commentary. "This activity is unnecessary and dangerous because it places our coastal economy, our marine ecosystems, our food system, our tourism and hospitality industries, and our community identity at serious risk."

item.title: When conflict meets competition: Trump’s immigration agenda roils opening days of Winter Olympics
item.description: The Olympics often intersect with political issues, and recent events have heightened tensions.

item.title: China critic and former media tycoon Jimmy Lai is sentenced to 20 years in a Hong Kong security case
item.description: His daughter Claire says the sentence means he will “die a martyr behind bars."

item.title: 49ers defensive end Keion White shot in ankle in San Francisco, team says
item.description: A San Francisco 49ers defensive end, Keion White, was shot in the ankle early Monday in San Francisco, suffered non-life-threatening injuries, and is recovering as police investigate the shooting with no arrests announced.
